sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: driving under the influence and license suspensions and revocations
Knowledge facts: part C holds 34 fact blocks (sec12-F01 onward) from physical pages 79 to 82; part C2 holds 14 confusable and continuation blocks (sec12-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-DUIS-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DUIS-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DUIS-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DUIS-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DUIS-D-UNDER21 — whether the under-21 .02% case and the under-18 juvenile-court case are suspensions or revocations (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NV-DUIS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-DUIS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: DUI fines, jail and prison ranges, the DUI school cost and the crash statistics are statutory or dated (for example sec12-F14, sec12-F15) and should be refreshed from current Nevada DMV material.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
